game_concept: A action puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool, a blue oasis pool: the caravan guide must handle giant scorpions while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Exception Rodeo: Wrap risky code in try/except to catch runtime errors without crashing.
theme: Sand Dunes – Oasis Pool: a blue oasis pool
core_gameplay_loop: In Oasis Pool, repeat each round: Wrap risky code in try/except to catch runtime errors without crashing. Each round, a new trade goods challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the stability value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 340 points of trade goods by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 340, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 7 (applied tier): Exception Rodeo
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exception Rodeo' (Week 9 slot 2), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Oasis Pool'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stability changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant scorpions in Oasis Pool.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 340 within 48 seconds.
